external_alignment.novel_mtt_input: the q79 Reynolds complement Q fixes the sector-controlled coupling and P/Q record labels; collision-model mathematics alone does not
external_alignment.repeated_interactions: Attal-Pautrat and later collision-model constructions show how fresh finite ancillas converge to quantum stochastic/Lindblad dynamics

finite_environment_no_go.consequence: exact continuous Markov damping requires fresh outgoing pointers, a field/Fock dilation or an equivalent singular weak-coupling limit
finite_environment_no_go.statement: a fixed bounded finite-pointer Hamiltonian starting from a product pointer state gives cos(theta t) or cos(theta t)^2 attenuation with zero dissipative derivative at t=0; it cannot equal exp(-gamma t) for positive gamma on an interval

repeated_interaction_semigroup.capture_clock: the first non-ready pointer has exponential total rate gamma_C and P/Q label weights proportional to the two quadratic responses
repeated_interaction_semigroup.continuous_limit: theta_Delta^2=gamma_C Delta+O(Delta^2); the Hamiltonian strength scales as Delta^(-1/2), the standard repeated-interaction/quantum-noise limit
repeated_interaction_semigroup.generator_jump_form: L_C(rho)=gamma_C(P rho P+Q rho Q-rho), with L_P=sqrt(gamma_C)P and L_Q=sqrt(gamma_C)Q
repeated_interaction_semigroup.grid_exactness: Phi_Delta^n=Phi_(n Delta) exactly for fresh pointers
repeated_interaction_semigroup.one_step_map: Phi_Delta(rho)=exp(-gamma_C Delta)rho+(1-exp(-gamma_C Delta))(P rho P+Q rho Q)

selection_principle.name: A_rec: minimal unbiased nondemolition q79 recorder
requirements: the coherent P_Haar sector and defect Q sector are not mixed
the coupling is uniform on each selected sector
the pointer has one prepared ready state and the minimum orthogonal record states
the interaction has no diagonal pointer bias or independent relative phase term
the two physical record channels have equal normalized coupling strength
selection_principle.uniqueness: the two-state defect recorder and three-state two-outcome capture recorder are unique up to pointer phases, orientation/sign and the one inherited dimensional rate scale

three_state_capture_recorder.hermitian_action_generator: H_3=i[P tensor J_ready,P + Q tensor J_ready,Q]
three_state_capture_recorder.minimality: one ready state plus two mutually orthogonal stable outcome records requires dimension at least three
three_state_capture_recorder.record_algebra: span{|ready><ready|,|P><P|,|Q><Q|}; each outgoing pointer decouples, so its diagonal record is stable

two_state_defect_recorder.hermitian_action_generator: H_2=i Q tensor J_ready,defect, gauge-equivalent to Q tensor sigma_y
two_state_defect_recorder.scope: minimal Stinespring recorder for defect/no-defect information; it has no distinct finite-time P record
